actions.name: warp_all
when: (partyAll('is_player and not is_me and distance < 15') and hasSpell('Warp II')) or \
(not partyAny('is_player and not is_me and distance < 15') and hasSpell('Warp'))

actions.name: sneak_all
when: partyAll('is_player and distance < 15 and not is_me and not hasBuff("Sneak")') or (me and not hasBuff('Sneak'))
commands: canUseSpell() and useSpell(member or me) and wait(5) or wait(1)

actions.name: invis_all
when: partyAll('is_player and distance < 15 and not is_me and not hasBuff("Invisible")') or (me and not hasBuff('Invisible'))
commands: canUseSpell() and useSpell(member or me) and wait(5) or wait(1)

actions.name: sneak_pt
when: partyAll('is_player and distance < 15 and not is_me and not hasBuff("Sneak")')
commands: canUseSpell() and useSpell(member) and wait(5) or wait(1)

actions.name: invis_pt
when: partyAll('is_player and distance < 15 and not is_me and not hasBuff("Invisible")')
commands: canUseSpell() and useSpell(member) and wait(5) or wait(1)

actions.name: follow

params.player or params.name or (log('No player parameter was specified. Use player:<player-name>.') and false)
not any(me.name, params.player or params.name) or (log('Cannot follow yourself.') and false)
commands: logf('Following player %s at distance=%.2f', player_result.name, params.distance or params.d or gambit.follow_distance)
-- We'll try to cancel the follow temporarily if we're casting or shooting
-- If conditions allow, we'll make sure we restart or continue the follow
((params._iter > 1 and following(player_result)) or follow(player_result, params.distance or params.d or gambit.follow_distance))

not (me.is_idle or me.is_mounted) and player_result and \

commands: log('Your follow operation has been cancelled.')
